svg.title: The toboggan’s curled prow, and the reason the sled is two parts. It is the one shape that says toboggan rather than plank, it sits at the leading edge where the rider’s folded shins cross it, and a prow drawn behind them is a prow nobody sees. Wood bent back on itself over about a third of a turn, the curve of `refs/quebec-city/toboggan-slide-riders.jpg`.
